notes: All rects are source pixels = layout units. Content starts at x=170 (army.png's rail is wider than collect's; the gutter 155..170 is ground).

Header: this screen's baked pills were larger than the shared chrome pills (gold 185..412, diamond 432..650, energy 668..903, y 24..84). They are inpainted; up to 15 px right of and 5 px below each shared pill shows inpainted sky. The might number's background (263,281,146,50) is inpainted too; the rendered number covers it.

Fonts: 'title' glyphs in the reference are ~25-30% narrower than Cinzel at the same cap height; sizes below are cap-height*1.4 and the width budget is the rect. 'body' is a transitional serif (Crimson Pro / EB Garamond are close).

Soldier cards in the reference are not uniform (x=174 w145 selected, 320 w149, 481 w147, 631 w137, next slot 778 w143). Template is card 3's frame (149x337); use pitch 151 -> slots at 174,325,476,627 and next slot at 778 which matches the reference exactly.

Soldier portraits come from art/reference/soldiers_sheet.png (art/slices/soldiers_sheet.json): every type in three looks, rough / fine / gilded, chosen by tier in client/scripts/ui/soldier_art.gd. The strip card draws portraits/soldier_<type>_<look> (133x164) in its window; the selected soldier draws portraits/soldier_<type>_<look>_large (202x286) in sel_window under the ring. The villager painted into army.png (and baked into army/selected_panel) is no longer cut on its own.

Tier numerals come from art/reference/numerals_sheet.png (art/slices/numerals_sheet.json): army/tier_1..7, the plain diamond, for every card and list; army/tier_large_1..7, the fleur diamond, for the selected soldier's badge. The painting's own I-III and the blank plate with the numeral in type are gone.
The troop bar is 100% full in the reference; army/troop_bar_full is the full bar, clip it from the left for partial values (no empty track exists in the reference).
army/card_selected_frame is a nine-patch drawn with draw_center=false over a card slot at offset (-2,-11), size 153x349, margins l8 t14 r10 b14.
Gear tile level badges: the plate under 'Lv. N' is kept (row-filled), text is live.

Recruit cards: chips were erased from the card art and are drawn as a nine-patch (army/recruit_chip, margins 8/6/8/6) at each card's chip rect, widths differ per card. Names, coins, (i) line and RECRUIT labels are baked.
